highlights: Committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children
Child protection, safeguarding, and healthcare data processing policies implemented
safety.policy_summary: SISB schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, expecting all staff, visitors, and volunteers to share this commitment. The privacy and child protection policies implement appropriate management measures regarding data processing, medical requirements, healthcare, and child protection in accordance with international standards and local PDPA laws.
